The '''1962–63 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 27th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 23 September 1962 and ended on 30 June 1963 with the play-off match. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] won their third Greek title and their first in 23 years.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
